versions.changelog: No changes detected in this version.

Initial release of ai-workflow-red-team-lite.

- Provides lightweight red teaming for AI automation workflows, focusing on misuse paths, boundary failures, and data leakage risks.
- Prioritizes defensive analysis and structured output: attack surface summary, misuse paths, boundary failures, data risks, mitigation advice, and exercise checklist.
- Enforces strict boundaries: no direct attack scripts, no destructive actions, and explicit boundary clarification for high-risk operations.
- Supports both shell/script-based and text-based workflows depending on environment capabilities.
- Designed for easy review and audit, with clear documentation and local resource usage.
